description: The chart is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the distribution of three outcomes (Win, Tie, Lose) for three systems: an unlabeled top row, GPT4o, and Doubao. The category axis is the vertical axis, listing the three systems from top to bottom in the order shown (unlabeled, GPT4o, Doubao). The value axis is the horizontal axis with a linear scale labeled from 0.0 to 1.0, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals, representing proportions that correspond to the percentages printed inside the bars. Each system’s bar is stacked into three colored segments according to the legend: Win in pink, Tie in light blue, and Lose in light green. The unlabeled top bar shows 32.0% Win (pink), 44.0% Tie (light blue), and 24.0% Lose (light green). The GPT4o bar shows 56.0% Win (pink), 18.0% Tie (light blue), and 26.0% Lose (light green). The Doubao bar shows 42.0% Win (pink), 36.0% Tie (light blue), and 22.0% Lose (light green). The bars appear to be normalized to a total length of 1.0 (100%) with no additional annotations beyond the percentage labels, and there is no indication that the categories are sorted by value or otherwise visually emphasized.
